title: Maximum overshadowing of a diagonally adjacent lot (Table 3.8a)
text: In climate zones 4, 5, and 6, development is designed that its shadow cast at midday, 21 June (refer Figure 3.8a) onto any other adjoining property and/or diagonally adjacent lot (refer Figure 3.8b) does not exceed the limits set out in Table 3.8a. Table 3.8a Maximum overshadowing (percentage of dwelling site area): Diagonally adjacent lots: R25 and lower 12.5%; R30-R40 17.5%; R50-60 25%.

replaces.note: Part B did not limit shadow on diagonally adjacent lots

notes: diverges: from ch3 C3.9.1-diagonal; the C3.9.2 single-storey exemption is removed (none in this chapter). Second column of Table 3.8a (half the adjoining figure). Not subject to C3.8.2 or C3.8.3. R10-R25: diagonal limit is new for apartments.
